rules.law_name: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase
rules.title: 2026-2027 annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units
rules.requirement: For San Francisco rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to rent-controlled units; the document does not define which units are rent-controlled.
coverage.summary: Covered tenancies are San Francisco rent-controlled units.

rules.interaction: The document also states that the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2025 through February 28, 2026 is 1.4%.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
